map.→ 打开上下文窗口占用工具: -> Open the context window usage tool
map.不同。同一段中文在 GPT/Claude/国产模型下 token 数差异明显，估: They differ. The same mixed Chinese-English text yields noticeably different token counts across GPT, Claude and domestic models, so the estimate is for reference only; exact values require the matching tokenizer.
map.不同模型 token 数一样吗？: Is the token count the same across models?
map.中英混排时中文按字或 subword 计，需以具体分词器为准估算。: In mixed Chinese-English text Chinese is counted per character or subword, so the estimate depends on the specific tokenizer.
map.为什么显示占用满了却还能聊？: Why does it show full usage but still allow chatting?
map.占用比=提示词 token + 生成 token / 窗口上限(如 4k/32k: Usage ratio = (prompt tokens + generated tokens) / context window limit (e.g. 4k/32k/128k).
map.占用率 = (系统提示 + 用户输入 + 预期回复) / 上下文窗口 × 100: Usage rate = (system prompt + user input + expected reply) / context window × 100%; remaining = window − used
map.占用超 100% 将截断，长任务应预留生成空间并定期压缩历史。: Overage above 100% will be truncated, so long tasks should reserve generation room and compact history regularly.
map.统计提示词与生成回复的 token 数，计算其对模型上下文窗口的占用比例，适用于: Counts the tokens of the prompt and the generated reply and computes their share of the model context window, for long-text handling, context truncation warnings and billing estimates.
map.规划对话时把预期回复长度一并计入，避免生成到一半撞上窗口上限被截断。长窗口模型虽: When planning a conversation, include the expected reply length as well, to avoid hitting the window limit mid-generation and being truncated. Long-window models may advertise huge limits, but attention cost grows with the square of length and mid-context content is easily ignored (lost-in-the-middle), so longer is not better.
map.部分实现会滚动丢弃最早历史以维持窗口，表现为'能继续但忘了开头'；严格实现则直接: Some implementations drop the oldest history in a rolling fashion to hold the window, which shows up as "it continues but forgot the beginning"; strict implementations raise an error instead. The usage ratio must reserve generation headroom.
map.：窗口 8k，提示 6k + 预计生成 2k = 8k 恰好满；若实际生成超 2: : with an 8k window, a 6k prompt plus 2k expected generation fills it exactly; if actual generation exceeds 2k it overflows. Keep prompts under 5k and leave 3k for generation.
